title: Half-Sunken Ship
description: A merchant vessel lists between jagged rocks, its hull split open by the tide. Barnacles coat every surface and seawater sloshes through the lower decks. The mast still flies a tattered pennant, snapping in the salt wind.

choices.label: Salvage the cargo hold
choices.description: Waterlogged timber still has value if you can haul it out.

choices.label: Search the captain's quarters
choices.description: The captain's lockbox might still hold coin.

choices.label: Pry barnacles from the hull
choices.description: The thick crustacean shells have use in crafting.

choices.label: Leave the wreck
choices.description: The groaning hull sounds ready to collapse.
